original_P_control.scope: completed attribute-only control; next segmentation stage intentionally blocked

scalar_units.loss: recorded objective units; components and weights must be considered
scalar_units.radius_mse: standardized log-radius squared error on reliable measurement domain
scalar_units.phase_elapsed_seconds: measured total phase wall time including validation/checkpoint overhead
scalar_units.successful_update: successful optimizer update; failed AMP attempts are excluded

attributes.support: CT-predicted continuous lumen occupancy at stride2; not calibrated confidence
attributes.radius: CT-predicted standardized log physical EDT radius, supervised only on reliable geometry

gaussian.target: mask*log1p(raw cumulative Gaussian sum)/fixed TRAIN foreground RMS
gaussian.prediction: Softplus of parallel F32 feature head
gaussian.loss_reduction: case equal; equal existing foreground/background region MSE
gaussian.inactive_loss_note: A reported diagnostic GDF MSE with zero applied weight does not imply GDF updates to S
gaussian.new_gdf_joint_r3: Not represented by these curves; later bounded target and Sigmoid/full-S runs must be published separately

validation.fixed_patch_bank: 64 fixed sampled VAL128-cubed patches; eight percase, eight VAL cases
validation.averaging: mean of patch scores within each case, then case-equal mean; not pooled voxel Dice
validation.empty_patch: both empty masks: Dice1; empty GT with any predicted foreground: Dice0
validation.native: separate native whole-case VAL8 endpoint evaluation; no direct subtraction against patch Dice

training_windows.source: all complete raw successful-update history rows
training_windows.mean: arithmetic mean of recorded batch scalars
training_windows.p10_p90: sorted observed window values at integer floor((n-1)*q)
training_windows.partial_last_window: allowed and explicitly counted; never filled to200

selection.base: actual downstream-loaded best_ready at27k after20k warm; selected S lineage47k
selection.postcondition: last endpoints, not retrospective best curve points

sampling_note: TRAIN case equal then anatomical anchor curriculum. Anchor-category weights differ from actual foreground voxel fractions. Requested/fallback category counts and observed B2 fractions are retained where logged.
amp_note: Skip indices inferred from consecutive successful-row attempt-counter gaps. Failed-batch losses or exact failed input identities were not logged.
current_scope: Single-seed recorded trajectories and native partial endpoints; no new optimization or TEST use in this export
